verses.sloka: हनुमानपि विश्रान्तः सर्वं शुश्राव तत्त्वतः ।सीतायास्त्रिजटायाश्च राक्षसीनां च तर्जनम् ।। ५.३०.१।।।।
verses.transliteration: hanumānapi viśrāntaḥ sarvaṁ śuśrāva tattvataḥ ।sītāyāstrijaṭāyāśca rākṣasīnāṁ ca tarjanam ।। 5.30.1।।।।

translations.english: The valiant hero Hanuman heard everything including the lamentation of Sita and the dream of Trijata and the threats of the demonesses.
translations.hindi: शाखाग्रों में छिपे, अर्जुन. वृक्ष के हरे रंग के वस्त्र पहिने, बिजली के समूह कीईतरह पीले, प्रियमापी, ग्रशोक के फूलों के ढेर की तरह कान्तिमान, सोते के सदृश पीले नेत्रों वाले ग्रौर ग्रति {नम्र होकर ब्रेठे हुए हनुमानजी को देख, सीताजी घवड़ा गई ्रौर बहुत विस्मित हुई । वे कहने लगीं, भरे ! इस दुर्घषं वानर का रूप तो बड़ा भयानक है

verses.sloka: अवेक्षमाणस्तां देवीं देवतामिव नन्दने ।ततो बहुविधां चिन्तां चिन्तयामास वानरः ।। ५.३०.२।।।।
verses.transliteration: avekṣamāṇastāṁ devīṁ devatāmiva nandane ।tato bahuvidhāṁ cintāṁ cintayāmāsa vānaraḥ ।। 5.30.2।।।।

translations.english: The sight of Sita who seemed a deity in the Nandana garden of Indra, set a chain of reflections in his mind :

verses.sloka: यां कपीनां सहस्राणि सुबहून्ययुतानि च ।दिक्षु सर्वासु मार्गन्ते सेयमासादिता मया ।। ५.३०.३।।।।
verses.transliteration: yāṁ kapīnāṁ sahasrāṇi subahūnyayutāni ca ।dikṣu sarvāsu mārgante seyamāsāditā mayā ।। 5.30.3।।।।

translations.english: "This is Sita whom thousands of vanaras are searching in all directions.

verses.sloka: चारेण तु सुयुक्तेन शत्रोः शक्तिमवेक्षता ।गूढेन चरता तावदवेक्षितमिदं मया ।। ५.३०.४।।।।
verses.transliteration: cāreṇa tu suyuktena śatroḥ śaktimavekṣatā ।gūḍhena caratā tāvadavekṣitamidaṁ mayā ।। 5.30.4।।।।

translations.english: "Roaming everywhere incognito to ascertain carefully the strength of the enemy, I have seen everything.
translations.hindi: प्रौर देखा नहीं जा सकता । यह जान कर सीता मूछित हो गईं । फिर बे भय से मोहित और दुःख से कातर हो, बहुत विलाप करने लगीं

verses.sloka: राक्षसानां विशेषश्च पुरी चेयमवेक्षिता ।राक्षसाधिपतेरस्य प्रभावो रावणस्य च ।। ५.३०.५।।।।
verses.transliteration: rākṣasānāṁ viśeṣaśca purī ceyamavekṣitā ।rākṣasādhipaterasya prabhāvo rāvaṇasya ca ।। 5.30.5।।।।

translations.english: "I have seen the ability of the demons and the citadel of Lanka. I have seen the power of Ravana the demon king.
translations.hindi: घीमे स्वर वाली दुःक्ियारी सती सीता, हा राम! हा लक्ष्मण ! [ कह कर, धीमी श्रावाज से बहुत रोई

verses.sloka: युक्तं तस्याप्रमेयस्य सर्वसत्त्वदयावतः ।समाश्वासयितुं भार्यां पतिदर्शनकांक्षिणीम् ।। ५.३०.६।।।।
verses.transliteration: yuktaṁ tasyāprameyasya sarvasattvadayāvataḥ ।samāśvāsayituṁ bhāryāṁ patidarśanakāṁkṣiṇīm ।। 5.30.6।।।।

translations.english: "It is the opportune time for me to comfort Sita eagerly waiting to see her husband who is of immeasurable prowess and who is compassionate to all beings.
translations.hindi: झाज मेने यह बड़ा बुरा स्वप्न देखा है । (बुरा क्यों ? ) क्योंकि स्वप्न में वानर का देखना शास्त्र में बुरा बतलाया गया है। सो लक्ष्मण सहित श्रीरामचन्द्रजी का तथा मेरे पिता महाराज जनकजी का मच्च हो

verses.sloka: अहमाश्वासयाम्येनां पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननाम् ।अदृष्टदुःखां दुःखार्तां दुःखस्यान्तमगच्छतीम् ।। ५.३०.७।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahamāśvāsayāmyenāṁ pūrṇacandranibhānanām ।adṛṣṭaduḥkhāṁ duḥkhārtāṁ duḥkhasyāntamagacchatīm ।। 5.30.7।।।।

translations.english: "The moonfaced Sita had never experienced sorrow before. She sees no end to her sorrow and suffering. I will console her.
translations.hindi: विनम्रमाव से उपस्थित कपिश्रेष्ठ हनुमानजी को देख, जानकीजी ने विचारा कि, कहीं मै स्वप्न तो नहीं देख रही ।।।! - SS SP inn सा वीक्षमाणा पृथुभुग्नवकत्रं शाखामृगेन्द्रस्य यथोक्तकारम्‌' ददशं “पिङ्गप्रवरं महाह वातात्मजं बुद्धिमतां वरिष्ठम्‌

verses.sloka: यद्यप्यहमिमां देवीं शोकोपहतचेतनाम् ।अनाश्वास्य गमिष्यामि दोषवद् गमनं भवेत् ।। ५.३०.८।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadyapyahamimāṁ devīṁ śokopahatacetanām ।anāśvāsya gamiṣyāmi doṣavad gamanaṁ bhavet ।। 5.30.8।।।।

translations.english: "If I should return to Kishkindha without reassuring Sita, whose understanding has been clouded in grief I would be blamed.
translations.hindi: उस समय सीता बहुत डर गई ग्रौर मूछित सी हो गई, श्रर्थात्‌ सकपका गईं मानो मृतप्राय हो गई हों फिर बहुत देर वाद सचेत हो, वे विशालनमबी सीता विचारने लगीं

verses.sloka: गते हि मयि तत्रेयं राजपुत्री यशस्विनी ।परित्राणमविन्दन्ती जानकी जीवितं त्यजेत् ।। ५.३०.९।।।।
verses.transliteration: gate hi mayi tatreyaṁ rājaputrī yaśasvinī ।paritrāṇamavindantī jānakī jīvitaṁ tyajet ।। 5.30.9।।।।

translations.english: "If I so back, this illustrious princess, Janaki will give up her life, finding no means of deliverance (from this tragic situation).

verses.sloka: मया च स महाबाहुः पूर्णचन्द्रनिभाननः ।समाश्वासयितुं न्याय्यः सीतादर्शनलालसः ।। ५.३०.१०।।।।
verses.transliteration: mayā ca sa mahābāhuḥ pūrṇacandranibhānanaḥ ।samāśvāsayituṁ nyāyyaḥ sītādarśanalālasaḥ ।। 5.30.10।।।।

translations.english: "I should provide some comfort to the strongarmed Rama with a face like the fullmoon yearning to see Sita.
translations.hindi: नोट--स्वप्नाध्यायानुसार स्वप्न म वानर का देखना बन्धुग्रों के लिए ग्रनिष्टकर माना गया है।] ही मट ( जानकीजी फिर विचार करने लगीं ) यह स्वप्न तो नदीं है । क्योंकि में थोड़े ही सो रही हूँ जो स्त्रप्न देखती । भला मुझ शोक भ्रौर दुःख से पीड़ित को नींद कब आने लगी निद्रा तो सुखियों को श्राती है। सो जब से मेरा उन-चन्द्रमुख श्रीरामचन्द्रजी से विद्लोह हुग्रा है तब से मुझे सुख केसा

verses.sloka: निशाचरीणां प्रत्यक्षमनर्हं चापि भाषणम् ।कथं तु खलु कर्तव्यमिदं कृच्छ्रगतो ह्यहम् ।। ५.३०.११।।।।
verses.transliteration: niśācarīṇāṁ pratyakṣamanarhaṁ cāpi bhāṣaṇam ।kathaṁ tu khalu kartavyamidaṁ kṛcchragato hyaham ।। 5.30.11।।।।

translations.english: "I cannot talk to her in the presence of these nightroamers. How can I discharge my duty in this predicament?
translations.hindi: इनका कारण तो मुझे यह जान पड़ता है कि, मँ रात-दिन श्रीरामजी के व्यान में रहती हूँ और श्रीरामजी का नाम रटा करती हँ । अतः मुझे तदनुरूप ही देख श्रौर सुन पड़ता है

verses.sloka: अनेन रात्रिशेषेण यदि नाश्वास्यते मया ।सर्वथा नास्ति सन्देहः परित्यक्ष्यति जीवितम् ।। ५.३०.१२।।।।
verses.transliteration: anena rātriśeṣeṇa yadi nāśvāsyate mayā ।sarvathā nāsti sandehaḥ parityakṣyati jīvitam ।। 5.30.12।।।।

translations.english: "If I do not comfort her before the remaining part of the night ends, she will give up her life. There is no doubt about it.
translations.hindi: सदा की भाँति आज भी में उन्हीं के वियोग में कन्दर्पे से पीडित हो बैठी हुई, उनका व्यान कर रही थी। फिर में तो सदा उन्हीं का ध्यान किया करती हूँ । इसीसे मुझे वेसा ही दिखलाई श्रौर सुनाई पड़ता है

verses.sloka: रामश्च यदि पृच्छेन्मां किं मां सीता ऽब्रवीद्वचः ।किमहं दं प्रतिब्रूयामसम्भाष्य सुमध्यमाम् ।। ५.३०.१३।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmaśca yadi pṛcchenmāṁ kiṁ māṁ sītā 'bravīdvacaḥ ।kimahaṁ daṁ pratibrūyāmasambhāṣya sumadhyamām ।। 5.30.13।।।।

translations.english: "If Rama enquires about the message of Sita, this lady of beautiful waist, what can I speak without meeting and talking to her?
translations.hindi: किन्तु इसका कारण तो मेरा मनोरथ है । यह बात श्म॑ समझती हूँ, बो भी बुद्धि इस बात को ग्रहण नहीं करती--वयोकि मेरे मनोरथ का एसा रूप नहीं जान पड़ता । श्रर्थात्‌ मेरा मनोर्थ तो श्रीरामचन्द्रजी के दर्शन का ' है, किन्तु यह तो वानर का दर्शन है और यह वानर मुझसे साफ-साफ वोन भी रहा है; इसका कारण क्या है?

verses.sloka: सीतासन्देशरहितं मामितस्त्वरया गतम् ।निर्दहेदपि काकुत्स्थः क्रुद्धस्तीव्रेण चक्षुषा ।। ५.३०.१४।।।।
verses.transliteration: sītāsandeśarahitaṁ māmitastvarayā gatam ।nirdahedapi kākutsthaḥ kruddhastīvreṇa cakṣuṣā ।। 5.30.14।।।।

translations.english: "If I leave this place without any message from Sita, Rama will burn me with his eyes full of great anger.
translations.hindi: । में बृहस्पति, इन्द्र, ब्रह्मा ग्रोर अग्नि को प्रणाम करती हूँ श्रौर प्राथना करती हें कि, इस वानर ने जो मेरे सामने भ्रभी कहा है, वह सच निकषे. और अन्यया न हो

verses.sloka: यदि चोद्योजयिष्यामि भर्तारं रामकारणात् ।व्यर्थमागमनं तस्य ससैन्यस्य भविष्यति ।। ५.३०.१५।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi codyojayiṣyāmi bhartāraṁ rāmakāraṇāt ।vyarthamāgamanaṁ tasya sasainyasya bhaviṣyati ।। 5.30.15।।।।

translations.english: "If I get the lord of vanaras and his army for the cause of Rama (without talking to Sita), their arrival will be useless (if Sita would have given up her life by then).

verses.sloka: अन्तरं त्वहमासाद्य राक्षसीनामिह स्थितः ।शनैराश्वासयिष्यामि सन्तापबहुलामिमाम् ।। ५.३०.१६।।।।
verses.transliteration: antaraṁ tvahamāsādya rākṣasīnāmiha sthitaḥ ।śanairāśvāsayiṣyāmi santāpabahulāmimām ।। 5.30.16।।।।

translations.english: "I shall wait and speak to her slowly and console this deeply distressed lady when I get a chance to speak to her (when these ogresses are asleep).

verses.sloka: अहं त्वति तनुश्चैव वानरश्च विशेषतः ।वाचं चोदाहरिष्यामि मानुषीमिह संस्कृताम् ।। ५.३०.१७।।।।
verses.transliteration: ahaṁ tvati tanuścaiva vānaraśca viśeṣataḥ ।vācaṁ codāhariṣyāmi mānuṣīmiha saṁskṛtām ।। 5.30.17।।।।

translations.english: I am indeed of small size and that too a monkey. Nevertheless I shall speak in Sanskrit, a language of the common people. (as the she-demons cannot understand that language).

verses.sloka: यदि वाचं प्रदास्यामि द्विजातिरिव संस्कृताम् ।रावणं मन्यमाना मां सीता भीता भविष्यति ।वानरस्य विशेषेण कथं स्यादभिभाषणम् ।। ५.३०.१८।।।।
verses.transliteration: yadi vācaṁ pradāsyāmi dvijātiriva saṁskṛtām ।rāvaṇaṁ manyamānā māṁ sītā bhītā bhaviṣyati ।vānarasya viśeṣeṇa kathaṁ syādabhibhāṣaṇam ।। 5.30.18।।।।

translations.english: "If I speak like a brahmin in sanskrit language she would be frightened thinking that I am Ravana and how would a vanara speak?

verses.sloka: अवश्यमेव वक्तव्यं मानुषं वाक्यमर्थवत् ।मया सान्त्वयितुं शक्या नान्यथेयमनिन्दिता ।। ५.३०.१९।।।।
verses.transliteration: avaśyameva vaktavyaṁ mānuṣaṁ vākyamarthavat ।mayā sāntvayituṁ śakyā nānyatheyamaninditā ।। 5.30.19।।।।

translations.english: "I will certainly speak to her meaningfully in the language of the people. Otherwise it is not possible to pacify the sinless Sita.

verses.sloka: सेयमालोक्य मे रूपं जानकी भाषितं तथा ।रक्षोभिस्त्रासिता पूर्वं भूयस्त्रासं गमिष्यति ।। ५.३०.२०।।।।
verses.transliteration: seyamālokya me rūpaṁ jānakī bhāṣitaṁ tathā ।rakṣobhistrāsitā pūrvaṁ bhūyastrāsaṁ gamiṣyati ।। 5.30.20।।।।

translations.english: "Since Janaki has already been frightened by the demons, she will be even more terrified seeing me in this form and hearing me speaking this way.

verses.sloka: ततो जातपरित्रासा शब्दं कुर्यान्मनस्विनी ।जानमाना विशालाक्षी रावणं कामरूपिणम् ।। ५.३०.२१।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato jātaparitrāsā śabdaṁ kuryānmanasvinī ।jānamānā viśālākṣī rāvaṇaṁ kāmarūpiṇam ।। 5.30.21।।।।

translations.english: By seeing me in this form, sensitive largeeyed Sita will scream loudly thinking that I am Ravana who can assume any form at his free will.

verses.sloka: सीतया च कृते शब्दे सहसा राक्षसीगणः ।नानाप्रहरणो घोरः समेयादन्तकोपमः ।। ५.३०.२२।।।।
verses.transliteration: sītayā ca kṛte śabde sahasā rākṣasīgaṇaḥ ।nānāpraharaṇo ghoraḥ sameyādantakopamaḥ ।। 5.30.22।।।।

translations.english: "If Sita screams, the horde of terrific ogresses will at once gather, armed with dreadful weapons like Yama, the god of death.

verses.sloka: ततो मां संपरिक्षिप्य सर्वतो विकृताननाः ।वधे च ग्रहणे चैव कुर्युर्यत्नं यथाबलम् ।। ५.३०.२३।।।।
verses.transliteration: tato māṁ saṁparikṣipya sarvato vikṛtānanāḥ ।vadhe ca grahaṇe caiva kuryuryatnaṁ yathābalam ।। 5.30.23।।।।

translations.english: "Then all these hideous ogresses will swarm round me and make efforts to capture me with all their strength and kill me.

verses.sloka: गृह्य शाखाः प्रशाखाश्च स्कन्धांश्चोत्तमशाखिनाम् ।दृष्ट्वा विपरिधावन्तं भवेयुर्भयशङ्किताः ।। ५.३०.२४।।।।
verses.transliteration: gṛhya śākhāḥ praśākhāśca skandhāṁścottamaśākhinām ।dṛṣṭvā viparidhāvantaṁ bhaveyurbhayaśaṅkitāḥ ।। 5.30.24।।।।

translations.english: "Seeing me holding big and small branches of large trees and leaping from one place to the other, the ogresses will get scared.

verses.sloka: मम रूपं च सम्प्रेक्ष्य वने विचरतो महत् ।राक्षस्यो भयवित्रस्ता भवेयुर्विकृताननाः ।। ५.३०.२५।।।।
verses.transliteration: mama rūpaṁ ca samprekṣya vane vicarato mahat ।rākṣasyo bhayavitrastā bhaveyurvikṛtānanāḥ ।। 5.30.25।।।।

translations.english: "These ogresses with their hideous faces will be frightened on looking at my huge form moving in this grove.

verses.sloka: ततः कुर्युः समाह्वानं राक्षस्यो रक्षसामपि ।राक्षसेन्द्रनियुक्तानां राक्षसेन्द्रनिवेशने ।। ५.३०.२६।।।।
verses.transliteration: tataḥ kuryuḥ samāhvānaṁ rākṣasyo rakṣasāmapi ।rākṣasendraniyuktānāṁ rākṣasendraniveśane ।। 5.30.26।।।।

translations.english: "Thereafter the ogresses will draw the attention of demon guards engaged by the king of demons at his residence towards me.

verses.sloka: ते शूलशक्तिनिस्त्रिंशविविधायुधपाणयः ।आपतेयुर्विमर्दे ऽस्मिन् वेगेनोद्विग्नकारिणः ।। ५.३०.२७।।।।
verses.transliteration: te śūlaśaktinistriṁśavividhāyudhapāṇayaḥ ।āpateyurvimarde 'smin vegenodvignakāriṇaḥ ।। 5.30.27।।।।

translations.english: "Those ogresses due to fear will come speedily, armed with spears, tridents, swords and different kinds of weapons for a combat.

verses.sloka: संरुद्धस्तैस्तु परितो विधमन् रक्षसां बलम् ।शक्नुयां न तु संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः ।। ५.३०.२८।।।।
verses.transliteration: saṁruddhastaistu parito vidhaman rakṣasāṁ balam ।śaknuyāṁ na tu saṁprāptuṁ paraṁ pāraṁ mahodadheḥ ।। 5.30.28।।।।

translations.english: "With them around me, I may not be able to reach the other end of the ocean (my strength spent in the combat.)

verses.sloka: मां वा गृह्णीयुराप्लुत्य बहवः शीघ्रकारिणः ।स्यादियं चागृहीतार्था मम च ग्रहणं भवेत् ।। ५.३०.२९।।।।
verses.transliteration: māṁ vā gṛhṇīyurāplutya bahavaḥ śīghrakāriṇaḥ ।syādiyaṁ cāgṛhītārthā mama ca grahaṇaṁ bhavet ।। 5.30.29।।।।

translations.english: "The ogres who are in large numbers, here are very prompt to act. They will jump into the sky and bind me. Sita will not receive the message and I will be taken into custody by the demons.

verses.sloka: हिंसाभिरुचयो हिंस्युरिमां वा जनकात्मजाम् ।विपन्नं स्यात्ततः कार्यं रामसुग्रीवयोरिदम् ।। ५.३०.३०।।।।
verses.transliteration: hiṁsābhirucayo hiṁsyurimāṁ vā janakātmajām ।vipannaṁ syāttataḥ kāryaṁ rāmasugrīvayoridam ।। 5.30.30।।।।

translations.english: "These demons who are keen on indulging in violence will harm Janaka's daughter. Then the mission of Rama and Sugriva will also fail.

verses.sloka: उद्देशे नष्टमार्गे ऽस्मिन् राक्षसैः परिवारिते ।सागरेण परिक्षिप्ते गुप्त वसति जानकी ।। ५.३०.३१।।।।
verses.transliteration: uddeśe naṣṭamārge 'smin rākṣasaiḥ parivārite ।sāgareṇa parikṣipte gupta vasati jānakī ।। 5.30.31।।।।

translations.english: "Janaki is staying in this untraceable location surrounded by demons. And this location is a secret place surrounded by the ocean .

verses.sloka: विशस्ते वा गृहीते वा रक्षोभिर्मयि संयुगे ।नान्यं पश्यामि रामस्य साहाय्यं कार्यसाधने ।। ५.३०.३२।।।।
verses.transliteration: viśaste vā gṛhīte vā rakṣobhirmayi saṁyuge ।nānyaṁ paśyāmi rāmasya sāhāyyaṁ kāryasādhane ।। 5.30.32।।।।

translations.english: "If I am killed in the combat or captured by the demons, I do not see another person who can help in accomplishing this task.

verses.sloka: विमृशंश्च न पश्यामि यो हते मयि वानरः ।शतयोजनविस्तीर्णं लङ्गयेत महोदधिम् ।। ५.३०.३३।।।।
verses.transliteration: vimṛśaṁśca na paśyāmi yo hate mayi vānaraḥ ।śatayojanavistīrṇaṁ laṅgayeta mahodadhim ।। 5.30.33।।।।

translations.english: "When I am killed here, I cannot see any other vanara who can leap over a hundred yojanas of the ocean (to reach this place).

verses.sloka: कामं हन्तुं समर्थो ऽस्मि सहस्राण्यपि रक्षसाम् ।नतु शक्ष्यामि संप्राप्तुं परं पारं महोदधेः ।। ५.३०.३४।।।।
verses.transliteration: kāmaṁ hantuṁ samartho 'smi sahasrāṇyapi rakṣasām ।natu śakṣyāmi saṁprāptuṁ paraṁ pāraṁ mahodadheḥ ।। 5.30.34।।।।

translations.english: "I may be capable of killing even thousands of demons but thereafter (thoroughly exhausted) reach the other side of the ocean.

verses.sloka: असत्यानि च युद्धानि संशयो मे न रोचते ।कश्च निस्संशयं कार्यं कुर्यात् प्राज्ञः ससंशयम् ।। ५.३०.३५।।।।
verses.transliteration: asatyāni ca yuddhāni saṁśayo me na rocate ।kaśca nissaṁśayaṁ kāryaṁ kuryāt prājñaḥ sasaṁśayam ।। 5.30.35।।।।

translations.english: "Battles, no doubt, are unpredictable. Which wise man with a sound intellect will take up a doubtful work unhesitatingly?

verses.sloka: प्राणत्यागश्च वैदेह्या भवेदनभिभाषणे ।एष दोषो महान् हि स्यान्मम सीताभिभाषणे ।। ५.३०.३६।।।।
verses.transliteration: prāṇatyāgaśca vaidehyā bhavedanabhibhāṣaṇe ।eṣa doṣo mahān hi syānmama sītābhibhāṣaṇe ।। 5.30.36।।।।

translations.english: "If I talk to Vaidehi it will be a great mistake on my part.If I do not speak to Vaidehi she may give up her life.

verses.sloka: भूताश्चार्था विनश्यन्ति देशकालविरोधिताः ।विक्लवं दूतमासाद्य तमः सूर्योदये यथा ।। ५.३०.३७।।।।
verses.transliteration: bhūtāścārthā vinaśyanti deśakālavirodhitāḥ ।viklavaṁ dūtamāsādya tamaḥ sūryodaye yathā ।। 5.30.37।।।।

translations.english: "Even well planned diplomatic missions fail like darkness dispelled at Sunrise if the messenger is confused and if the place and time are not propitious for them.

verses.sloka: अर्थानर्थान्तरे बुद्धिर्निश्चिता ऽपि न शोभते ।घातयन्ति हि कार्याणि दूताः पण्डितमानिनः ।। ५.३०.३८।।।।
verses.transliteration: arthānarthāntare buddhirniścitā 'pi na śobhate ।ghātayanti hi kāryāṇi dūtāḥ paṇḍitamāninaḥ ।। 5.30.38।।।।

translations.english: "Swinging from a course of action or an action leading to calamity is not proper. Messengers who assume that they are scholars (blinded by ego) destroy their mission.

verses.sloka: न विनश्येत् कथं कार्यं वैक्लव्यं न कथं भवेत् ।लङ्घनं च समुद्रस्य कथं नु न वृथा भवेत् ।। ५.३०.३९।।।।
verses.transliteration: na vinaśyet kathaṁ kāryaṁ vaiklavyaṁ na kathaṁ bhavet ।laṅghanaṁ ca samudrasya kathaṁ nu na vṛthā bhavet ।। 5.30.39।।।।

translations.english: "How can the mission succeed? How can failure of mission be avoided? How can the crossing of the great ocean be not wasted?"

verses.sloka: कथं नु खलु वाक्यं मे श्रुणुयान्नोद्विजेत वा ।इति संचिन्त्य हनुमांश्चकार मतिमान् मतिम् ।। ५.३०.४०।।।।
verses.transliteration: kathaṁ nu khalu vākyaṁ me śruṇuyānnodvijeta vā ।iti saṁcintya hanumāṁścakāra matimān matim ।। 5.30.40।।।।

translations.english: Wise Hanuman came to a decision after reflecting in his mind about how not to create fear in Sita (while communicating with her.)

verses.sloka: राममक्लिष्टकर्माणं स्वबन्धुमनुकीर्तयन् ।नैनामुद्वेजयिष्यामि तद्बन्धुगतमानसाम् ।। ५.३०.४१।।।।
verses.transliteration: rāmamakliṣṭakarmāṇaṁ svabandhumanukīrtayan ।naināmudvejayiṣyāmi tadbandhugatamānasām ।। 5.30.41।।।।

translations.english: "By praising Rama who is very dear, who is judicious in action and in whom her mind is absorbed, I will not create fear.

verses.sloka: इक्ष्वाकूणां वरिष्ठस्य रामस्य विदितात्मनः ।शुभानि धर्मयुक्तानि वचनानि समर्पयन् ।। ५.३०.४२।।।।
verses.transliteration: ikṣvākūṇāṁ variṣṭhasya rāmasya viditātmanaḥ ।śubhāni dharmayuktāni vacanāni samarpayan ।। 5.30.42।।।।

translations.english: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.

verses.sloka: श्रावयिष्यामि सर्वाणि मधुरां प्रब्रुवन् गिरम् ।श्रद्धास्यति यथा हीयं तथा सर्वं समादधे ।। ५.३०.४३।।।।
verses.transliteration: śrāvayiṣyāmi sarvāṇi madhurāṁ prabruvan giram ।śraddhāsyati yathā hīyaṁ tathā sarvaṁ samādadhe ।। 5.30.43।।।।

translations.english: "I shall present in auspicious words the esteemed Rama of Ikshvaku family who is a knower of self and make her listen to everything in such a sweet manner that she will trust me.

verses.sloka: इति स बहुविधं महानुभावो जगतिपतेः प्रमदामवेक्षमाणः ।मधुरमवितथं जगाद वाक्यं द्रुमविटपान्तरमास्थितो हनूमान् ।। ५.३०.४४।।
verses.transliteration: iti sa bahuvidhaṁ mahānubhāvo jagatipateḥ pramadāmavekṣamāṇaḥ ।madhuramavitathaṁ jagāda vākyaṁ drumaviṭapāntaramāsthito hanūmān ।। 5.30.44।।

translations.english: Highsouled Hanuman seated on the branch of the tree without being seen began to speak faithfully in praise of the lord of the universe in many ways while looking at her. इत्यार्षे श्रीमद्रामायणे वाल्मीकीय आदिकाव्ये सुन्दरकाण्डे त्रिंशस्सर्गः।। Thus ends the thirtieth sarga of Sundarakanda of the holy Ramayana, the first epic composed by sage Valmiki.
